product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Ingrid Commercial Grade Windsor Dining Chairs - Black Solid Wood Spindle Back Chairs - Armless Kitchen or Dining Room Chairs - No Assembly Required
features: BEAUTIFULLY SIMPLE: Functional armless dining chair boasts clean lines and blends schoolhouse and cottage styles with a saddled seat that is comfortable even without a cushion
GLOSSY FINISH: Available in a black or white finish, the casual look allows this chair to easily pair with most dining tables
COMMERCIAL QUALITY: Constructed from premium solid rubberwood that holds up to 600 LBS. static weight
EASY CARE: Wipes clean with a damp cloth and requires no assembly for instant enjoyment
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS: Overall Size (2): 16.75"W x 17.75"D x 34.75"H; Seat Size: 16.75"W x 14.5"D x 17.5"H; Back Size: 18"W x 17.5"H; No Assembly Required
description: Refresh your decor while adding strong, sturdy seating to your business or residential space with this set of 2 Windsor style commercial grade spindle back chairs. Featuring a glossy painted finish, available in 2 colors, these traditional chairs with saddled seats for comfort, are an elegant cross between schoolhouse and cottage style that will grace your living room or bedroom just as easily as your restaurant dining room. Constructed from high-quality solid wood for long-lasting durability, these commercial quality chairs hold up to 600 lbs. static weight each and will stand up to the rigors of the hospitality industry and your busy household. The armless design allows these chairs to tuck under the table giving you much needed floor space when not in use. Felt pads protect your flooring surfaces when the chairs are moved and add stability when seated and with no assembly required, setup is quick and easy. Wipe clean with a damp cloth to keep your new accent side chairs looking brand new.
